title: Live Dialogue
description: Latihan percakapan kerja 2–4 giliran: dengarkan lawan bicara, pilih & ketik respons English-mu, lalu speak-back. Lebih dekat ke fluent meeting.

items.scenario: Incident bridge. Checkout 5xx is rising. You are primary on-call; your manager joins late and asks for a crisp update.
items.scenarioId: Bridge insiden. Checkout 5xx naik. Kamu primary on-call; manajer masuk belakangan dan minta update yang ringkas.
items.prompt: Complete the bridge conversation — your turns.

choices.text: Something is broken. Looking into it.
choices.textId: Ada yang rusak. Sedang dicek.

choices.text: Checkout 5xx is about 18% and rising. I'm investigating and will share a mitigation plan in five minutes.
choices.textId: Checkout 5xx sekitar 18% dan naik. Saya sedang investigasi dan akan bagikan rencana mitigasi dalam lima menit.

choices.text: Probably yesterday's deploy, but I'm not sure.
choices.textId: Mungkin deploy kemarin, tapi saya tidak yakin.

choices.text: Can someone else take this? I just got paged.
choices.textId: Bisa orang lain yang handle? Saya baru di-page.

items.explanation: Di percakapan bridge, tiap giliranmu harus: dampak + metrik + aksi + ETA update. Hindari spekulasi tanpa owner. Latih speak-back agar lidah terbiasa.

items.scenario: A VP pushes to skip canaries for a hot fix before a partner demo.
items.scenarioId: VP mendorong skip canary untuk hot fix sebelum demo partner.
items.promptId: Sampaikan ketidaksetujuan secara profesional dalam percakapan.

choices.text: That is reckless and I will not do it.
choices.textId: Itu sembrono dan saya tidak akan melakukannya.

choices.text: I understand the urgency. Skipping canaries increases blast radius. I recommend a 5-minute canary on 5% traffic with auto-rollback. If we must go faster, please confirm we accept the elevated risk.
choices.textId: Saya paham urgensinya. Skip canary memperbesar blast radius. Saya rekomendasikan canary 5 menit di 5% traffic dengan auto-rollback. Jika harus lebih cepat, tolong konfirmasi kita menerima risiko yang lebih tinggi.

choices.text: Whatever you say.
choices.textId: Terserah Anda saja.

choices.text: I will complain in a side channel after the meeting.
choices.textId: Saya akan mengeluh di channel samping setelah meeting.

items.explanation: Acknowledge urgency → state risk → offer safer alternative → clarify who owns the risk decision.

items.scenario: Offer negotiation call. Base is 10% below your target; you still want the role.

choices.text: Thank you for the offer. I am excited about the role. Based on market data and my scope in reliability ownership, I am targeting X base. Is there flexibility to move closer to that number?
